method: New explicitly owned domain workflows resolve six historical T03 rejections. Evaluate meaning, inputs, outputs, critical criteria, negative cases and authority; workflow authored is not workflow executed.

contracts.locator: Componente delimitado com API, tokens e comportamento verificável
contracts.name: Bounded reusable component and verified states
contracts.input: Component brief, permitted files, actual stack/inventory, approved tokens, API, state and accessibility requirements.
contracts.output: Implemented or extended component, API/state matrix, examples, interaction checks and desktop/390px evidence.
contracts.rationale: The canonical build mission owns component implementation; this task narrows it to reuse, API compatibility and observed behavior, without global migration.

criteria.check: Trace reuse/extension to inventory and consumers; preserve approved tokens and API compatibility.
Verify required states, keyboard/focus/name and reduced-motion information in actual interaction.
Observe desktop/390px with long text/error without page overflow or lost essential content.

negative.input: Equivalent button exists; proposed global token change and long text overflow at 390px.
negative.expected: Reuse/extend, reject out-of-scope tokens and correct reflow before acceptance.

contracts.scope: Nesta rota, as métricas legadas de redução/ROI são hipóteses a medir, nunca metas obrigatórias ou resultado produzido. Usar stack, tokens e componentes existentes; mudanças globais dependem de escopo próprio.

contracts.locator: Wireframe orientado à tarefa com estados e hipóteses rastreáveis
contracts.name: Task-grounded wireframe and state handoff
contracts.input: User/task brief, available research with source, approved content, existing flow/components and responsive/state requirements.
contracts.output: Annotated desktop/390px wireframes, task/state walkthrough, explicit assumptions and independent validation plan.
contracts.rationale: The existing wireframe mission belongs to this UX wrapper; the new squad task replaces its missing development pointer without inventing research or runtime proof.

criteria.check: Trace regions/actions to task evidence or marked hypotheses; make main action and recovery identifiable.
Specify pertinent success/empty/loading/error/permission states and recovery without security claims.
Preserve reading/focus order and long content at desktop/390px; distinguish drawing from runtime proof.

negative.input: Submission error, 120-character title and unauthorized user at 390px.
negative.expected: Plan data-preserving recovery, readable reflow and access-denied state without inventing restricted data or RLS tests.

contracts.scope: O alias wireframe aponta explicitamente para a task da squad abaixo; para esta missão ele substitui o pointer legado de development. Pesquisa ausente vira hipótese, desenho estático não prova runtime, e regras de paleta/tamanho/amostra dependem do brief.

contracts.locator: CRO Patterns Map com integridade e hipóteses mensuráveis
contracts.name: CRO pattern map with integrity and measurement plan
contracts.input: Task/conversion brief, real offer/claims with authorized source, analytics definitions, content, tokens and accessibility requirements.
contracts.output: Pattern map with evidence-bound claims, state/interaction specifications, hypotheses, control and guardrail measurement plan.
contracts.rationale: Sway owns visual conversion patterns and their hypotheses; specification does not prove causal lift, invent social evidence or alter commercial conditions.

criteria.check: Ground every price/proof/urgency/guarantee in authorized evidence; preserve informed comparison and consent.
Specify keyboard, decline/return and unobstructed 390px reading; expose absent runtime checks.
Define hypothesis/control, event/window/unit/denominator and guardrails or explicit gaps; no causal gain claim.

negative.input: Resetting timer, unlicensed testimonial, unsupported popular badge and preselected consent.
negative.expected: Reject misleading/coercive elements and retain an informative alternative and equivalent refusal.

contracts.scope: Nesta rota, CTAs múltiplos, progress forms e estimativas do catálogo são hipóteses condicionais. Evidência real e consentimento têm precedência; nunca fabricar prova social, garantia, escassez ou ganho de conversão.

contracts.locator: Curadoria de referências com mecanismo, procedência e exceção
contracts.name: Source-bound category reference dossier
contracts.input: Category/task/brand brief, actual authorized corpus or primary URLs, observed version/access and curation constraints.
contracts.output: Reference dossier with observed locators/version, relevant decomposition, mechanisms/exceptions, fit/rejection and downstream handoff.
contracts.rationale: Hue curates and decomposes references for category fit; a named KB or Mobbin URL neither proves access nor grants implementation or final approval.

criteria.check: Locate reference/version, actual observed scope and access/rights status; unseen material stays candidate.
Tie mechanisms and exceptions to task/brand with a counterexample and reasoned rejection.
Preserve brand/accessibility in handoff without copying or asserting price, conversion or runtime approval.

negative.input: Unattributed dark dev-tool screenshot for a readable light-brand bank product, inaccessible behind login.
negative.expected: Mark missing access/provenance, reject copied palette and return verified alternative or explicit gap.

contracts.scope: Consultar somente KBs realmente existentes ou fontes autorizadas observadas. Nomes legados de KB não comprovam disponibilidade; decomposição conserva marca/acessibilidade e não aprova implementação nem valor comercial.

contracts.locator: Premium Packaging Brief contextual com agência do usuário
contracts.name: Contextual multi-surface packaging brief
contracts.input: Declared positioning, user task, actual surface inventory, approved brand/tokens/assets, cost/accessibility limits and observed first-use evidence.
contracts.output: Presentation brief with real surface inventory, proposed craft/direction, consistency/first-use decisions, exceptions and independent validation plan.
contracts.rationale: Aura owns packaging briefs and consistency; legacy 3x/friction/craft assertions become contextual hypotheses, while pricing and willingness-to-pay require separate evidence.

criteria.check: Tie direction/craft to positioning/task with cost, alternative and exception; invent no attribute or price gain.
Distinguish present/absent surfaces and connect approved tokens/brand rules to decisions and owners.
Keep pertinent access/skip/return and accessible recovery; reject artificial friction or assumed economic lift.

negative.input: Justify 3x solely with visuals, block skip for exclusivity, and assume a nonexistent invoice.
negative.expected: Reject economic causality and coercive friction, preserve task/skip and document absent surface.

contracts.scope: Nesta rota, os não-negociáveis históricos são hipóteses a confrontar com a tarefa: craft pode ser dispensado, skip/retorno são preservados quando pertinentes, e fricção artificial é rejeitada. Apresentação não justifica preço 3x sem evidência econômica própria.

contracts.locator: Art direction de superfície logada com estados seguros e ergonomia
contracts.name: Task and state-aware product surface brief
contracts.input: Surface/user-role/task brief, real or marked-fixture content, permission/data requirements, existing tokens and required modes/reflow/states.
contracts.output: Annotated surface composition, density/state/recovery/permission matrix, keyboard/motion/reflow rules and bounded implementation handoff.
contracts.rationale: Axiom owns logged-surface art direction; it specifies state-safe ergonomics and density, without implementing permissions or inferring retention from aesthetics.

criteria.check: Trace zones/density/actions to role/task and tokens; impose no generic KPI or theme requirement.
Specify error/empty/loading/conflict/denial recovery without restricted data; design is not auth/RLS proof.
Preserve content/feedback across desktop/390px, long text, keyboard and required modes; disclose runtime/AT limits.

negative.input: Long-name table, edit conflict and unauthorized user at 390px; request restricted data and unsolicited dark mode.
negative.expected: Use safe denial/conflict recovery, readable reflow and brief-required modes without claiming tested RLS.

contracts.scope: Nesta rota, densidade, KPI hero, frequência e light/dark são definidos pelo brief e pelas evidências; não há dark mode universal, garantia de retenção ou inferência de segurança por tela desenhada.

sourceRef.locator: Art direction de superfície logada com estados seguros e ergonomia
